adjudication.rationale: In the new endpoint `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` will throw on malformed input, and `symmetricDecrypt(...)` plus `JSON.parse(...)` will throw on bad ciphertext/misconfigured `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`. There is no try/catch or `safeParse` with explicit 4xx responses, so these failures will bubble to Next.js and return HTTP 500 rather than a controlled 4xx for invalid requests/config, matching the finding.
